newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cheung Kong offers extra Kingswood units.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Kong offers extra Kingswood units.

text.p: Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd said on Saturday it would offer an additional 64 units at its Kingswood Villa residential development for sale at HK$4,480 a square foot, versus an initial price of HK$4,089 per square foot.
Earlier, the property developer said the first batch of units on offer was 78 times subscribed at the close of a four-day registration period on Friday.
The flats would be sold by ballot on March 30, it said.
The units put up for sale were in the final phase of the development located in Tin Shui Wei in Hong Kong's New Territories, it said.
